sloka: ददर्श सा त्विला तस्मिन्बुधं सोमसुतं तदा ।ज्वलन्तं स्वेन वपुषा पूर्णसोममिवोदितम् ।। ७.८८.९ ॥
transliteration: dadarśa sā tvilā tasminbudhaṁ somasutaṁ tadā ।jvalantaṁ svena vapuṣā pūrṇasomamivoditam ।। 7.88.9 ॥

translations.english: Then, Ilā saw Budha, the son of Soma, in that place, shining with his own body like the risen full moon.
